note: Weekly pool for the For your setup card. devices: reader must own 1 of these (empty = everyone). types: user_type bonus. wants: wants bonus. Written each Monday.

items.title: Give any Shortcut its own keyboard shortcut on Mac
items.text: Open the Shortcuts app, double-click a shortcut, click the info (i) button, then Add Keyboard Shortcut. Your most-used automation is now 2 keys away from any app.

items.title: Tap the back of your iPhone to run anything
items.text: Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Back Tap. Set Double Tap to a screenshot, the flashlight or any Shortcut. It works through most cases.

items.title: Turn paper into a clean PDF without a scanner app
items.text: Open a note in Notes, tap the paperclip, then Scan Documents. The iPhone finds the page edges, flattens the shot and saves a PDF inside the note.

items.title: Hold the space bar to move your cursor
items.text: Press and hold the space bar on the iPhone keyboard. The keys go blank and the whole keyboard becomes a trackpad, so you can drop the cursor exactly where you want.

items.title: Option-click the Wi-Fi icon for the details Apple hides
items.text: Hold Option and click Wi-Fi in the menu bar. You get your IP address, signal strength and the channel you're on, which tells you fast whether slow internet is your router or your Mac.

items.title: Find your iPhone from your wrist, even in the dark
items.text: Open Control Center on your Watch and tap the Ping iPhone button. Touch and hold it instead and your iPhone flashes its light too.

items.title: Share 1 movie with 2 pairs of AirPods
items.text: Connect your AirPods, open Control Center, tap the AirPlay icon on the music player, then Share Audio. Bring the second pair close and both of you hear the same thing.

items.title: Swipe from the corner for an instant Quick Note
items.text: On iPad, swipe up from the bottom-right corner with your finger or Apple Pencil. A Quick Note opens over any app, and it links back to the page or app you were in.

items.title: Lost the Apple TV remote? Your iPhone is one
items.text: Open Control Center and tap the remote icon. If it isn't there, add Apple TV Remote in Control Center settings. It also gives you a real keyboard for search.

items.title: The Mac and iPhone app deals still running
items.text: Every app deal on our list is checked by hand and sorted by device, so you only see deals for gear you own.

items.title: Record your Mac screen without any app
items.text: Press Shift, Command and 5. You get buttons to record the whole screen or just a box, plus Options to add your mic and a 5-second timer.

items.title: Make your iPhone do something every time you plug it in
items.text: Shortcuts > Automation > New Automation > Charger. Pick Is Connected, set it to Run Immediately, and add any action: Low Power Mode off, a playlist, a Focus.

items.title: Remove a photo's background in 2 clicks on Mac
items.text: In Finder, right-click an image, then Quick Actions > Remove Background. You get a new copy with a clear background. No app, no upload.

items.title: Command and the key above Tab flips between windows
items.text: Command-Tab jumps between apps. Command and ` (the key above Tab on most keyboards) jumps between windows of the same app, like 2 Safari windows.

items.title: Keep your Mac awake for 1 long task
items.text: Type caffeinate in Terminal and your Mac won't sleep until you press Control-C. Use caffeinate -i followed by your command and it stays awake only while that command runs.
